summary: SUI Group Holdings Ltd. filed Form 8-K on July 14, 2026, disclosing the resignation of Chief Investment Officer Stephen Mackintosh, effective July 8, 2026. The resignation was stated to not involve any disagreement with the company regarding financial reporting, operations, policies, or practices. Chairman Marius Barnett will oversee the transition until a replacement is appointed. Separately, the board is evaluating an enhanced management structure for future strategic development.
